examples.zh: 「你希望最迟什么时候拿到」？我下课后可以放在架子上。

collocations: when would you like it by today
when would you like it by this week
ask when you would like it by

words.expression: shall I wait here
words.lemma: shall i wait here
words.enDefinition: checks whether staying in the current place would be helpful

examples.en: Shall I wait here while you find the right label for the box?
examples.zh: 你找箱子对应的标签时，「我就在这儿等吗」？

examples.en: Shall I wait here, or would it help if I came with you?
examples.zh: 「我就在这儿等吗」？还是我陪你过去会更有帮助？

collocations: shall I wait here for you
shall I wait here until you come back
ask if I should wait here

words.expression: would it help if I took one
words.lemma: would it help if i took one
words.enDefinition: offers to carry one item to make someone's task easier
acceptedEnVariants: would it help if I took one

examples.en: Would it help if I took one of the folders while you open the cupboard door?
examples.zh: 你打开柜门时，「要我帮你拿一个文件夹吗」？

examples.en: Would it help if I took one? You look like you need a free hand here.
examples.zh: 「要我帮你拿一个吗」？看起来你这会儿得腾出一只手。

collocations: would it help if I took one of the bags
ask if it would help if I took one
would it help if I took one downstairs

words.expression: shall we do it together
words.lemma: shall we do it together
words.enDefinition: suggests sharing the task instead of doing it individually

examples.en: Shall we do it together so we can get the table through the doorway?
examples.zh: 「要不咱俩一起做」？这样能把桌子搬过门口。

examples.en: Shall we do it together after I bring the rest of the signs downstairs?
examples.zh: 我把剩下的牌子拿下楼后，「要不咱俩一起做」？

collocations: shall we do it together now
shall we do it together before class
ask if we should do it together

words.expression: what would make this easier
words.lemma: what would make this easier
words.enDefinition: invites someone to say what kind of help would be useful

examples.en: What would make this easier for you while I have both hands free anyway?
examples.zh: 反正我这会儿能腾出双手，「怎么做会容易些」？

examples.en: She asked, "What would make this easier?" when she saw the piles of books.
examples.zh: 看到那几摞书时，她问：「怎么做会容易些」？

collocations: ask what would make this easier
what would make this easier for you
think about what would make this easier

words.expression: give me a signal
words.lemma: give me a signal
words.enDefinition: asks someone to provide a sign when they are ready

examples.en: Please give me a signal when you want me to open the door.
examples.zh: 要我开门的时候，请「给我个信号」。

examples.en: Can you give me a signal from the other side of the table?
examples.zh: 你能从桌子另一边「给我个信号」吗？

collocations: remember to give me a signal
please give me a signal
give me a signal when you're ready

words.expression: point out what needs moving
words.lemma: point out what needs moving
words.enDefinition: to show another person which items they should move

examples.en: Could you point out what needs moving before I start clearing the smaller shelf?
examples.zh: 我开始清理小一点的架子前，你能「指出哪些东西需要挪」吗？

examples.en: I asked my neighbour to point out what needs moving in the crowded hallway.
examples.zh: 我请邻居在挤满东西的走廊里「指出哪些东西需要挪」。

collocations: offer to point out what needs moving
ask someone to point out what needs moving
please point out what needs moving

words.expression: would you rather I left it here
words.lemma: would you rather i left it here
words.zhGloss: 你更希望我把它留这儿吗
words.enDefinition: asks if leaving something in its present location is preferred
acceptedZhAnswers: 你更希望我把它留这儿吗
acceptedEnVariants: would you rather I left it here

examples.en: Would you rather I left it here, or should I take it down to the entrance?
examples.zh: 「你更希望我把它留这儿吗」？还是该拿到入口那儿？

examples.en: Would you rather I left it here until the others have finished using the table today?
examples.zh: 直到今天其他人用完桌子，「你更希望我把它留这儿吗」？

collocations: would you rather I left it here until lunch
ask if you would rather I left it here
would you rather I left it here for you

words.expression: is it okay if I do it later
words.lemma: is it okay if i do it later
words.enDefinition: asks for permission to complete a requested task later
acceptedEnVariants: is it okay if I do it later

examples.en: Is it okay if I do it later after I take these books back to the library?
examples.zh: 我把这些书还到图书馆之后再做，「晚点做可以吗」？

examples.en: Is it okay if I do it later? I promised to help my roommate with something first.
examples.zh: 「我晚点做可以吗」？我答应先帮室友做点事。

collocations: is it okay if I do it later this evening
ask if it is okay if I do it later
is it okay if I do it later today

words.expression: could we do one at a time
words.lemma: could we do one at a time
words.enDefinition: asks to handle items or tasks individually rather than together
acceptedEnVariants: could we do one at a time

examples.en: Could we do one at a time so we don't put the wrong label on anything?
examples.zh: 「能不能一次做一个」？这样就不会把标签贴错。

examples.en: Could we do one at a time? There isn't enough space to spread everything out here.
examples.zh: 「能不能一次做一个」？这儿没地方把所有东西都摊开。

collocations: could we do one at a time here
ask if we could do one at a time
could we do one at a time for now

words.expression: is one enough
words.lemma: is one enough
words.enDefinition: checks whether a single item meets the other person's need

examples.en: Is one enough, or would you like two copies for your group?
examples.zh: 「一个够吗」？还是你希望给你们组两份？

examples.en: Is one enough to hold the doors, or should I get another?
examples.zh: 用来挡门，「一个够吗」？还是我再拿一个？

collocations: is one enough for the group
is one enough for each table
ask if one is enough

words.expression: just tell me what needs doing
words.lemma: just tell me what needs doing
words.enDefinition: expresses willingness to help once the other person specifies the task
acceptedEnVariants: just tell me what needs doing

examples.en: Just tell me what needs doing and I'll get started while you sort those papers.
examples.zh: 「就告诉我该做什么」，你整理文件时我就能动手。

examples.en: I said, "Just tell me what needs doing," when I arrived to help set up chairs.
examples.zh: 我到场帮忙摆椅子时说：「就告诉我该做什么」。

collocations: go ahead and just tell me what needs doing
ask them to just tell me what needs doing
please just tell me what needs doing

words.expression: I'll make sure it gets there
words.lemma: i'll make sure it gets there
words.enDefinition: accepts responsibility for getting something to the intended place or person
acceptedEnVariants: I'll make sure it gets there

examples.en: I'll make sure it gets there before the others return to the room this evening.
examples.zh: 「我会确保把它送到」，赶在其他人今晚回到房间之前。

examples.en: My classmate said, "I'll make sure it gets there," when I handed her the spare key.
examples.zh: 我把备用钥匙交给同学时，她说：「我会确保把它送到」。

collocations: say I'll make sure it gets there
don't worry, I'll make sure it gets there
yes, I'll make sure it gets there

words.expression: say when
words.lemma: say when
words.enDefinition: asks someone to tell you when they have enough

examples.en: Just say when and I'll stop pouring water into your glass.
examples.zh: 「够了就说一声」，我就不往你杯子里倒水了。

examples.en: I'll keep handing you blank sheets, so just say when.
examples.zh: 我继续给你递空白纸，「够了就说一声」。

collocations: just say when
say when you've got enough
tell them to say when
